'''Kevin George The last of his religion CHOKK''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Kevin George]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19057">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19057 The last of his religion  CHOKK], DeckTech (Kevin "Enforcer" George, 23 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19057/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19057/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017020631/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19057/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kevin George]]
* '''Published:''' 23 September 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''The last of his religion  CHOKK''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' A Hunt down which does win and is good.
